name: Fresh embeddings
summary: Re-embed rows whose source text changed so vector search stays accurate

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: FRESHNESS_BATCH_SIZE
env.description: Rows examined per invocation. Each stale row becomes one queued re-embed job.

env.name: FRESHNESS_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Must match the model used originally, or re-embedded vectors are not comparable with the rest of the index.

env.name: FRESHNESS_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
env.description: Must match the model and the vector column width.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Detect rows whose embedded text changed and queue re-embeds. Five minutes is a deliberate compromise: row-event triggers would make this near-instant.

operations.title: POST /sources
operations.description: Register a table whose text should stay embedded.

operations.title: POST /scan
operations.description: Cron. Detect changed rows and queue re-embeds.

operations.title: GET /pending
operations.description: Rows currently known to be stale.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
